## 2026-07-21 15:48 UTC -- Sweep 2: #465 cross-check + scoped proposal (sweep)

Cross-checked #465 (docs: convert ignore blocks to no_run) against the code. Findings that correct the issue text:
- Count is STALE: 118 `ignore` code fences in src/ (not 79).
- NOT mechanical: most blocks use `.await` and `?` at module scope, which is exactly why they are `ignore`. `no_run` still requires the example to COMPILE, so each block needs a hidden async/`Result` wrapper (e.g. `# async fn wrapper() -> Result<(),Box<dyn Error>> { ... # Ok(()) # }`). A blind s/ignore/no_run/ would fail the Documentation CI gate (hard gate).
- `no_run` IS the right tool for the connect() examples: they compile-check without needing a live server.

Decision: do NOT propose the whole issue (too big, mislabeled). Proposing a bounded slice: convert the 11 module-doc blocks in redis-tower/src/lib.rs to no_run with hidden async wrappers, verify `cargo test --doc`, draft PR. Partially addresses #465; issue stays open. Awaiting gate.
